title: metadata: DatabaseLoader is locale-blind for a bundled type, so saving one locale of an email template overwrites another locale's row in the same (package, name) slot
body:
domain:server#7 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYm8sWjp2Pk76warN7w

Child of the ADR-0150 epic #31527. This defect was measured by the #31699 dev in round 4 of PR #32214 (report 6795944262, out-of-scope finding, class a). It already exists on `main`; #32214 does not introduce it.

**Where.** In `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts`, `baseFilter` has no `bundle_member`, so `save` and the single-package `registerRollback` target the first row of the name's (package, name) slot, whatever its locale.

**What happens.** Measured probe: a save of `fr-FR` into a slot that holds `en-US` overwrote the `en-US` row. The rows went from `[[A,null,en-US,1],[A,fr-FR,fr-FR,2]]` to `[[A,null,fr-FR,3],[A,fr-FR,fr-FR,2]]`. The same happens on `main` through the name's first row. `email_template` is the only bundled type today.

**Do:**
1. Measure on `main` once #32214 lands:
   - a save of each locale of a two-locale bundle;
   - a rollback of each locale.
2. Make `save` / `registerRollback` target the member's row: `(package, name, bundle_member)`, with the canonical member stored as `NULL` (`overlayMemberValue`).
3. Pin that each locale saves and rolls back alone and that the other locale is untouched. Ablate once.

**Serial:** after #32214, which fixes the read half (loadMany / loadManyKeyed keep every member) under the epic ruling on that PR.
**Clause-②:** the claimer declares it.
**Business reason:** editing one language of an email template silently destroys another language's customization.

Dedupe (`DatabaseLoader bundle_member locale overwrite`, `email_template save loses locale`): none found.
